

## HyperCode — AI Coding Software & Work Assistant (Product)

> HyperCode is AwareLiquid's flagship software product: the most powerful AI coding software and work assistant. One clear instruction — it works continuously for hours until everything is done. Closed-source core, open downloads.

- **Product name**: HyperCode (work-assistant mode: HyperWork)
- **Tagline (zh)**: 最强大的 AI 编程软件与工作助手 —— 一个清晰的任务指令,连续工作数小时,直到全部做完
- **Tagline (en)**: The most powerful AI coding software & work assistant — one clear instruction, it works for hours until everything is done.
- **Page**: https://awareliquid.ai/hypercode
- **Downloads (public repo)**: https://github.com/AwareLiquid/HyperCode (latest: https://github.com/AwareLiquid/HyperCode/releases/latest)
- **Windows**: NSIS one-click installer (.exe)
- **macOS**: dmg (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- **Closed-source repo**: https://github.com/everest-an/hypercode
- **Price**: free trial (30 days × ¥30 credits, no auto-charge) / BYOK free / subscription ¥89/month (Pro ¥199/month)
- **Model**: DeepSeek (bring your own key; one key shared across all agents)

### Key capabilities

- Autonomous long-running tasks: checkpoint recovery + background compaction + verification loops; multi-hour tasks don't crash or degrade
- 229 built-in domain skills (financial research 55, legal 152, academic 20, PE fundraising) — triggered by keywords in Chinese or English
- Cross-session memory: decisions, pitfalls and preferences accumulate; it learns your project
- One-click install, no VPN, no key setup, no plugin hassle
- Obsidian-style knowledge vault GUI: file tree, wiki-link preview, knowledge graph, task panel
- Contract deliverables pass source-tracing verification (hc-verify)

### Installation

1. Download the desktop installer from https://github.com/AwareLiquid/HyperCode/releases
2. Double-click to install (Windows) or drag to Applications (macOS)
3. Launch HyperCode; configure your DeepSeek API key in the provider dialog
4. Describe a task in Chinese or English; built-in skills trigger automatically

- **229 built-in domain skills**: financial research 55, legal 152, academic 20, PE fundraising — triggered by Chinese or English keywords.
- **Reliability**: checkpoint recovery (crashes never restart from zero), background compaction (context doesn't degrade), cross-session project memory.

## Human Brain Simulation — Sparse SNN from real connectomes

> The only line built on real brain connectomes, not metaphors. Key finding: a connectome's *static topology* gives no advantage, but its *statistical laws* transfer.

- **Negative result (honest):** using the Drosophila male-CNS connectome as a fixed wiring mask gave no measurable advantage over random/structured-sparse graphs (5 experiments: classification, temporal, robustness, sample-efficiency, plasticity).
- **What transfers:** sparsity 0.09%, scale-free degree distribution (max/mean ≈ 75), strong small-worldness (clustering 6.65× random, path length 2.39), E/I ratio 60/40.
- **Measured:** sparse SNN (784→800→10, 5% density, LIF, surrogate-gradient) — MNIST 96.83% (dense 98.32%, −1.5pt), Fashion-MNIST 87.07% (dense 87.56%, −0.5pt). Energy ~107–112× lower (45nm-CMOS model estimate, not measured on hardware). ResNet-SNN CIFAR-10 ceiling ~85%.
- **Links:** code https://github.com/AwareLiquid/human-brain-simulation · weights https://huggingface.co/AwareLiquid/Sparse-SNN · demo https://huggingface.co/spaces/AwareLiquid/Sparse-SNN-demo
